-- ============================================
-- MM2 Trade Bot v4 — VirtualInput Touch Sim
-- Generated by Cobalt — https://gitlab.com/upio/cobalt
-- Simulates real screen touch on accept button
-- ============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Trade = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Trade", 10)
local SendRequest = Trade:WaitForChild("SendRequest", 10)
local OfferItem   = Trade:WaitForChild("OfferItem", 10)
local AcceptTrade = Trade:WaitForChild("AcceptTrade", 10)

local TARGET_USERNAME = "aquxtic_jaz"
local ITEM_DATAID     = "Strawberries_G_2026"
local ITEM_TYPE       = "Weapons"

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

-- *finds the button in space, touches it like a human would*

local function safeCall(fn, label)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    print("[CobaltBot] " .. label .. (ok and " ✓" or " FAILED: " .. tostring(err)))
end

local function getTarget()
    local t = 0
    local target
    repeat
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
        target = Players:FindFirstChild(TARGET_USERNAME)
    until target or t >= 15
    return target
end

-- get absolute screen position of a GUI element
local function getButtonScreenPos(btn)
    local abs = btn.AbsolutePosition
    local size = btn.AbsoluteSize
    -- center of button
    return Vector2.new(
        abs.X + size.X / 2,
        abs.Y + size.Y / 2
    )
end

-- simulate real touch on a position
local function touchPosition(pos)
    -- finger down
    VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(pos.X, pos.Y, 0, true, game, 1)
    task.wait(0.05)
    -- finger up
    VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(pos.X, pos.Y, 0, false, game, 1)
    task.wait(0.05)
    print("[CobaltBot] Touch simulated at " .. math.floor(pos.X) .. "," .. math.floor(pos.Y))
end

-- find any visible button matching accept keywords
local function findAcceptButton(gui)
    local keywords = {"accept", "confirm", "ready", "ok", "trade"}
    for _, desc in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if (desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("ImageButton")) and desc.Visible then
            local name = desc.Name:lower()
            local text = ""
            if desc:IsA("TextButton") then
                text = desc.Text:lower()
            end
            for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
                if name:find(kw) or text:find(kw) then
                    return desc
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- nuclear option — touch bottom center of screen where accept usually lives
local function touchFallback()
    -- MM2 accept button on mobile sits roughly 75% down center of screen
    local pos = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.75)
    print("[CobaltBot] Fallback touch at screen center-bottom")
    touchPosition(pos)
end

local function run()
    print("[CobaltBot] Starting — looking for " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. "...")

    local target = getTarget()
    if not target then
        warn("[CobaltBot] Target not found. Stopping.")
        return
    end
    print("[CobaltBot] Found target ✓")

    safeCall(function()
        SendRequest:InvokeServer(target)
    end, "SendRequest")

    local desktopGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI", 30)
    local phoneGui   = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI_Phone", 30)
    local tradeGui   = nil
    local guiOpened  = false

    local function onOpen(gui)
        if not guiOpened then
            guiOpened = true
            tradeGui = gui
        end
    end

    local c1 = desktopGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if desktopGui.Enabled then onOpen(desktopGui) end
    end)
    local c2 = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if phoneGui.Enabled then onOpen(phoneGui) end
    end)

    local t = 0
    while not guiOpened and t < 30 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
    end
    c1:Disconnect()
    c2:Disconnect()

    if not guiOpened then
        warn("[CobaltBot] Trade never opened. Stopping.")
        return
    end

    print("[CobaltBot] Trade GUI open ✓")
    task.wait(0.5)

    safeCall(function()
        OfferItem:FireServer(ITEM_DATAID, ITEM_TYPE)
    end, "OfferItem")

    print("[CobaltBot] Waiting 6s for accept window...")
    task.wait(6)

    -- loop: try remote + find button + touch it + fallback
    local tradeDone = false
    local closeConn
    closeConn = tradeGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if not tradeGui.Enabled then
            tradeDone = true
            if closeConn then closeConn:Disconnect() end
        end
    end)

    local attempts = 0
    while not tradeDone and attempts < 20 do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        print("[CobaltBot] Accept attempt " .. attempts)

        -- 1. fire remote
        safeCall(function()
            AcceptTrade:FireServer()
        end, "AcceptTrade remote")

        -- 2. find button and touch its real screen position
        local btn = findAcceptButton(tradeGui)
        if btn then
            local pos = getButtonScreenPos(btn)
            touchPosition(pos)
        else
            -- 3. nuclear fallback — touch where accept button usually is
            touchFallback()
        end

        task.wait(0.4)
    end

    if tradeDone then
        print("[CobaltBot] Trade completed ✓ — leaving...")
    else
        print("[CobaltBot] Max attempts reached — leaving anyway...")
    end

    task.wait(1.5)
    TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end

task.spawn(run)
